fields.title: URL column
fields.description: Select the input column containing the URLs.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Image types
fields.description: Select which image types are valid in the input. If a non-valid type is encountered it will handle the error according to the "Fail on invalid input" option.

fields.title: Fail on invalid input
fields.description: If selected, the node will fail during execution if any URL is invalid or points to an invalid image file. If unselected, the node will skip these invalid entries and insert a missing value instead.

fields.title: Custom image read timeout
fields.description: Defines the connection and read timeout for the used URL connections in seconds. The default is 1 second if it is not overwritten by the 'knime.url.timeout' system property.

fields.title: Append new column
fields.description: If selected, appends a new column with the images. Otherwise, replaces the input column.
